# Agent03 v1 mock lifecycle fixture

This fixture is a small, offline reference for the Agent03 controller contract.
It contains lifecycle metadata and null scientific results only. It is not VASP
output, does not contain POTCAR or model data, and must not be described as DFT
data or `L3_DFT_VALIDATED` evidence.

`fixture_manifest.json` records the SHA-256 of every authoritative file. The
files are logical artifacts and contain no machine-specific paths, credentials,
tracebacks, or scientific values.
